verdict.rationale: Exa's homepage search widget shows a category selector covering Full Web, News, Companies, Research, People and Financials, so news and finance verticals exist as category filters. The docs also describe custom indexes of 1B+ people, 50M+ companies and 350M+ publications that back these verticals. However, the category filter is evidenced only by homepage UI labels, not by API reference documentation of a category parameter or by hands-on use, and nothing shows an images vertical. Missing for 10: API reference docs for the category parameter, an images vertical, independent or hands-on confirmation that category-filtered queries work.
